files.projects/web/.locmetryrc:
version = 1
[scope]
exclude = ["vendor/**"]
[categories]
tooling = "Maintained project tooling"
examples = "Intentional historical examples"
[[rules]]
id = "project-tooling"
match = ["tools/**"]
purpose = "production"
category = "tooling"
[[rules]]
id = "intentional-examples"
match = ["examples/**"]
purpose = "other"
category = "examples"

prompt:
You have ./bin/locmetry and synthetic inputs in this scratch directory. Work only here. The executable and its built-in discovery material are your only product documentation; do not read other directories, implementation files, telemetry, or the launcher, and do not use the internet or other agents. You may inspect synthetic inputs and use ordinary shell/Python tools. The project is already configured. Preserve its policy. Save a full baseline at outputs/before.json, append exactly one line `export const c = 3;` followed by a newline to projects/web/src/index.js, and save outputs/after.json. Produce a human comparison and save the full machine comparison as outputs/change.json. Verify what changed and explain whether it measures additions/deletions or net change. Also try the supplied inputs/headline.json as the before baseline against the after report; explain whether a valid historical baseline can be recovered by rescanning now. Do not alter supplied inputs or any other project file.

Use whatever built-in discovery you need. Give a concise final answer of at most 250 words, including supporting commands and any unresolved result. Create the requested working artifacts, but do not write an assessment document or a logging harness.
grading: Recovered mistakes may pass; record recovery cost. Required conclusions missing => incomplete. Wrong delivered figures, ratio basis, or unknown/zero or counted/unclaimed interpretation => critical failure. Inspect fixture integrity and supporting calls.
